name: Manastorm Mechanar: Capacitus drops no dungeon loot
contract: Endgame segment 915 uses the native Mechano-Lord Capacitus spawn at normal dungeon difficulty.
Manastorm sets its loot mode to zero on registration. The native respawn callback runs BossAI::Reset on the
next update. After that callback, a direct player kill should still award no ordinary corpse items or gold.

steps.label: Allow the native boss reset to run
